summary: Backend + frontend regression for the new JMeter plugin download endpoints and download page. All 9 pytest backend tests passed (plugin.info shape, plugin.jar with correct java-archive MIME, attachment disposition, size + PK signature; demo HTML served inline; PDF with %PDF- signature + attachment; PPTX with PK signature + correct MIME; JSON contains schema_version; smoke jmx with attachment; path traversal returns 400; missing file returns 404). Frontend loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, renders all four sections with expected data-testids, lists Performance_Report .html/.pdf/.pptx/.json (+.csv), smoke deck lists smoke-notifiers.jmx / run-notifier-smoke.sh / README.md, and the v2.0.3 changelog contains all four bullet items. Fetching the plugin jar href from the frontend context returned 42,206,406 bytes with content-type application/java-archive and PK\x03\x04 signature.
critical_code_review_comments: _safe_child path-traversal guard works, but the resolve() check `base.resolve() not in p.parents` will reject when name equals base itself; harmless here since is_file() also fails first. Consider using p.relative_to(base) for a clearer guard.
plugin/info returns URLs relative (e.g. '/api/downloads/plugin.jar'); frontend correctly prefixes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. No issue but worth documenting.
The demo section on the frontend also lists Performance_Report.csv (5 items) - not in the review checklist but not incorrect.
seed_data_creation: None - static files already present on disk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_downloads.py; run with pytest. Endpoints are unauthenticated. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL currently points to https://jmeter-observability.preview.emergentagent.com.
